title: Slayer observatory ecosystem scene
description: The opt-in ecosystem v1 schema of Set: recipes, films with a print and rig, cameras and their eye, placement, stands within one another, a set's bounds, assets and texts, the HUD, the world, the planet and prescribed weather. It holds the keys the reader takes; domain references, cross-references and GPU support are checked by the reader and the renderer.

timeofday.description: The time on the scene's clock, hhmm. With a date, a location and utc-offset it works the sun.

date.description: The day, year-month-day. With a location, timeofday and utc-offset the sun's azimuth and altitude are worked from them by scene/daylight; a scene that says this says no sun azimuth or altitude.

utc-offset.description: The hours the scene's clock is ahead of UTC, from -12 to 14 (the clock timeofday is read on).

relief.description: The least steepness, rise over run, of the ground made below the map, at edges up to longest metres.

reflectance.description: The share of red, green and blue light the ground gives back, in linear light.

sea.description: The elevation of still water that fills the low ground, on the model's own datum.

near.description: A finer window cut from the same model about a place inside this one, which the terrain does not draw where it lies.

cover.description: How the ground is coloured by rule: the sea's level on the model's datum, and surfaces from the ground up, each laid over those before it where its height above the sea and its slope hold. Not to be said with reflectance.

level.description: The sea's height in metres on the model's datum. Said only where the terrain says no sea; where it does, the terrain's sea is the level and a level that differs is refused.

reflectance.description: The share of red, green and blue light the surface gives back, in linear light.

height.description: Metres above the sea the surface lies at: from, until or both, each end softened over blend, centred on it.

slope.description: Rise over run the surface lies at: from, until or both, each end softened over blend, centred on it.

made.description: Ground made finer than a window's survey wherever the camera resolves finer, not said with a detail or a near window: the survey's own roughness continued below its spacing, and the flutes and beds said, on ground steeper than steep.

flutes.description: Channels cut down a steep face: how deep, and how far apart, in metres.

beds.description: Ledges standing out of a steep face: how far apart in height, and how far each stands out, in metres.

part-spin.description: Optional native material-group local-axis motion, supported only with setting: space. Omitted preserves static geometry.

parts.description: For kind scavenged-cluster: the kinds its parts are drawn from, each with a weight.

count.description: For kind scavenged-cluster: how many parts.

parcel.description: For kind superblock: the width, east to west, and the depth, north to south, of the parcel it is built over.

ceiling.description: For kind superblock: the most storeys a building has.

habit.description: For kind superblock: how the parcel is built over; accreted is plot by plot, each against the last.

accretion.description: For kind superblock: how far the block is grown over, from planned at 0 to grown over at 1, or drawn from the seed. Drawn when not said.

occupants.description: For kind superblock: the people the planned block is built for; with the crowding they say the slabs' storeys.

crowding.description: For kind superblock: the crowding its people tolerate, occupancy over design.

band_spacing.description: For kind scavenged-cluster: the distance between bands along a lashing.

frontage.description: For habit frontage: the line of a channel the stand's items stand along. of is the channel; side is left or right of its line as one goes along it from its first point; setback is how far from the outer face of the channel's wall the fronts stand, away from the water, and negative toward it; gap is the room between one run of terrace and the next. The habit takes no within or area.

climb.description: For habit contour: how rows of terraces climb the slope, one above the next, along its contours. rows is how many; runs is how many straight runs of terrace make a row, end to end; lane is the gap between one row and the one above it; door is the way the fronts, and so the doors, look, down the slope or up it. The stand's within says where the first row starts (of), and how far from there a run may start (far).

angstrom.description: the particles' Angstrom exponent: unsaid, the mist is as thick to every colour.

nitrogen-dioxide.description: nitrogen dioxide mixed through the mist where it is thickest, parts in a thousand million.

edge.description: how far under its top the mist holds its whole density before thinning to nothing, as under a lid.

size.description: the size of the patches; unsaid, the depth.

base.description: a cloud deck's base, a scene height.

top.description: a cloud deck's top, a scene height.

plume.description: smoke or steam from a mouth, or many laid round a point, carried down the weather's wind.

diffuse-sky-samples.description: CPU-only equal-solid-angle samples over the air-side sky hemisphere for opt-in CPU ocean single-scattering against the infinite mean-plane continuation.

clear-cloud-sky-samples.description: CPU-only refracted air-sky samples for clear-water-compatible local cloud sources, independent of water scattering.

clear-cloud-water-step-mode.description: CPU-only mixed-medium water quadrature: legacy full budget per cloud gap, or explicit full-ray target cell spacing. Ray-spacing changes quadrature and is not bit-exact.

unbounded.description: true: the wave bands are summed at every point, so the sea has no edge and says no extent and no samples.

water-composition.description: Independent sourced water observations. Optical coefficients remain separately supplied.

value.description: Suspended sediment concentration in milligrams per litre.
Measured turbidity in formazin nephelometric units.

extinction-per-metre.description: Authored red, green and blue unscattered extinction coefficients in inverse metres. The material key names the medium.

lamp-fields.description: Crowds of small lamps. Each field scatters count lamps by a seed, evenly through the box from low to high, every one the same temperature, strength and radius. The same file draws the same lamps.

beams.description: Finite Gaussian light columns. Radius and reach use world units; divergence is a geometric half-angle in degrees.

axis.description: Optional nonzero map east/north/up direction of local +Y; omitted preserves world-up.

clear-water.description: CPU-only bounded cloud composited segment by segment with named clear-water extinction.

phase-g.description: Explicit independent Henyey-Greenstein cloud phase; zero is isotropic. Requires clear-water true; omission inherits water phase.

clear-water.description: CPU-only bounded field composed segment by segment with named clear-water extinction.

phase-g.description: Explicit independent Henyey-Greenstein cloud phase; zero is isotropic. Requires clear-water true; omission inherits water phase.

pace.description: A film: seconds of weather that pass in a second of scene time, from the moment on. Unsaid, every frame shows the moment.

turning.description: A film: degrees the planet turns eastward in a second of scene time. Unsaid, it does not turn.

initial-media.description: Ordered clear material names that explicitly contain the camera at the start of every frame.

beyond.description: how far past the terrain's edge the layer reaches, each way across.

toward.description: the thing the layer is thickest over, the reach at which it has thinned to its least, and that least as a share.
